functional_ops.decoder_upsampling: F.interpolate(x, scale_factor=2, mode='nearest') at the start of every decoder block
functional_ops.squeeze_excite_pooling: F.adaptive_avg_pool2d(x, 1) (global average pooling) inside every MBConv block's squeeze-and-excitation
functional_ops.head_activation: torch.sigmoid applied to the logits at evaluation time (not part of the model)
